proposal.summary: Authenticated stored/reflected cross-site scripting in eScan Management Console 14.0.1400.2281 via the 'from' parameter on ewconsole.dll/editUserName which can be used to steal admin session cookies.
proposal.cwe_quote:
Now, Inject the Cross Site Scripting Payload in "from" parameter as
shown below and a valid XSS pop up appeared.

PR.quote: 1. Login into the eScan Management Console with a valid user credential.

UI.quote:
Now, Inject the Cross Site Scripting Payload in "from" parameter as
shown below and a valid XSS pop up appeared.

C.quote:
By exploiting this vulnerability, any arbitrary attacker could have
stolen an admin user session cookie to perform account takeover.

I.quote:
By exploiting this vulnerability, any arbitrary attacker could have
stolen an admin user session cookie to perform account takeover.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and reproduce the XSS in a test environment, confirm whether the vulnerability is reflected or stored and whether the payload is executed in an administrator context; then remediate by properly encoding or validating the 'from' parameter server-side.
